chunks: Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may Allah be pleased with him) told us, saying: My father told us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa told us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz informed me, saying: Musa ibn Isma'il told me from his father, from Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, from the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him), saying:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) sent a brigade, and when they returned, he said: Welcome to a people who have performed the Minor Striving and upon whom remains the Major Striving. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, and what is the Major Striving? He said: Combating one's self. He, peace be upon him, said: The best of striving is that of the one who combats his self that is between his sides.

key_terms.بَيْنَ جَنْبَيْهِ: Between his sides (referring to the self within)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the Minor and Major Striving in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Mani al-Akhbar*, this hadith establishes the internal struggle against the self (nafs) as superior to external military conflict, a concept deeply rooted in Shia spiritual psychology. It highlights the Prophet’s teaching that while physical jihad is temporary, the continuous effort to purify the soul represents the ultimate and enduring form of devotion.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Hussain bin Ahmad bin Idrees, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by my father, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Isa, that he said: I was informed by Muhammed bin Yahya al-Khazzaz, the Silk Maker, that he said: I was told by Musa bin Isma’eel, from his father, from Musa bin Ja’far, from his father, from his fathers, from the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, that he said:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, once sent a brigade, and when they returned, he said: Welcome to a people who have performed the Minor Striving and upon whom remains the Major Striving. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, and what is the Major Striving? He said: Combating one’s self. He, peace be upon him, said: The best of striving is that of the one who combats his self that is between his sides.
